How to Connect TikTok LIVE Studio

Works for you and any friend or other streamer
Step 1: Enter your TikTok Username

Type your TikTok handle (e.g. @yourname or your profile handle) in the top input box and click Connect.
💡 Note: If you are not live yet, the button will show Waiting for Stream. That is normal! It will stand by and connect as soon as you start your live stream.

Step 2: Add Overlay Link in TikTok LIVE Studio

In TikTok LIVE Studio (or OBS Studio):
1. Click + Add Source → Select Link (Browser source).
2. Copy & paste this URL:

Recommended Size: 1920x1080 (Landscape) or 1080x1920 (Portrait).
Step 3: Click "Go LIVE" in TikTok LIVE Studio

Start your broadcast! The studio will turn Connected automatically, and all gifts, 50k overall likes, and followers will trigger in Plants vs Zombies Fusion in real time!

About Gift Spinner

Gift Spinner Overlay Mechanics:

1. Streamers add the standalone overlay (http://localhost:8080/overlay-spinner.html) into OBS / TikTok LIVE Studio as a transparent browser source.

2. When viewers send linked gifts, the horizontal reel smoothly spins and decelerates with realistic physics.

3. The prize stopping directly under the yellow triangle pointer triggers the in-game spawn command in PvZ Fusion!
